estimates: The museum documents a 5.8° lean. The architectural account identifies the Kompanii side as the settled side. The exterior uses a uniform shear toward that side and approximates the variation in settlement.

The mapped footprint is exact to the source vector precision. The façade opening census and positions, eaves, ridge, balcony metalwork and current finishes are estimates based on the written architectural description and building data.
The model covers the museum building itself, excluding the neighboring 1877 bank, cellar interior, and former stables and coach house.

The public-domain art images depict collection objects and other subjects. The exact 1914 photograph is held as a copy with unevaluated rights. The model uses the museum’s written explanation, the architectural record, and native mapped geometry.
